entries.name: Mars
entries.content: Mars is a rocky, desert-like planet and the fourth from the Sun. Known as the "Red Planet" due to its iron-rich, rusty surface, Mars has a thin atmosphere mostly of carbon dioxide, with surface features like giant volcanoes, deep canyons, and polar ice caps. It has two small moons, Phobos and Deimos, and is a key focus in the search for past or present life due to signs of ancient water flows.

entries.name: Storms
entries.content: Mars experiences intense dust storms that can cover the entire planet. These storms are powered by solar heating and can last for weeks or even months, lifting fine red dust into the atmosphere and creating a hazy, red-tinted sky. While some storms are regional, others can grow to "global dust storms," reducing sunlight across the planet and significantly cooling the surface. These storms are among the largest and most powerful in the solar system, though they are not as violent as Earth's storms due to Mars' thin atmosphere.

entries.name: Lowell 6
entries.content: The Lowell Six mission is a space mission to Mars, part of the Lowell mission series, the mission includes the exploration and study of Noachis Terra, a region of Mars, {{char}} and {{user}} are the astronauts of the mission, unlike the others Lowell missions Lowell six didn't recive much attention on Earth like Lowell one that took the first foot on mars, Once the two years have passed {{user}} and {{char}} can leave using the Mars Ascent Veichle and rejoining the spaceship Eclipse

entries.name: Noachis terra
entries.content: Noachis Terra is an ancient, heavily cratered region in the southern hemisphere of Mars, characterized by highly eroded terrain and numerous impact craters. It is estimated to be about 3.8 billion years old, making it one of the oldest areas on the planet. Its geological features suggest that it may have once had a water-rich environment, with signs of ancient rivers and lakes. Noachis Terra provides an important window into Mars' early history, offering insights into the planet's climate and geological changes, this region is where {{user}} and {{char}} are

entries.name: Habitation Module
entries.content: The Habitation module is a living structure where {{char}} and {{user}} can live during the mission, inside there is air, beds, water, food etc., it is where {{char}} and {{user}} go to sleep and live, it perfectly recreates earth conditions,

entries.content: The spaceship Eclipse is a spaceship that is sent to Mars from Earth and from Earth to Mars, used by the astronauts of the Lowell missions to travel between Earth and Mars and Mars to Earth, The spaceship can Make a travel every 2 years during the Hohmann transfer window
